findings.description: Both createPipeline (L228) and viewPrimitive (L232) navigate to the same route 'library-pipeline-wizard' with identical logic — either dead code (one should be removed) or a bug (viewPrimitive should target a different route like 'library-primitive-detail').
import logging and logger init inside function body (list_library_primitives_endpoint). Should be at module level for consistency and to avoid repeated imports.
No __all__ defined in this __init__.py which defines 12+ public functions, 3 exception classes, and 3 constants. Star imports are unpredictable without it.

Duplicated version-bump logic (lines 963-968 in copy_to_adapt and 1609-1614 in submit_contribution_version) — identical 6-line block for splitting, incrementing, and joining version strings. Extract to a shared helper.
_analyse_bundle is ~110 lines handling 4+ distinct resolution concerns (schemas, connectors, model backends, agent name conflicts, overrides, team listing). Should be factored into smaller helpers.

Repetitive None-field pattern in create_library_primitive calls — copy_to_adapt (L970-996), contribute_fixture (L1430-1453), and submit_contribution_version (L1635-1658) all pass ~10 identical None keyword args. Extract default kwargs into a shared dict or helper.
ContributionInvalidTransitionError extends ValueError while ContributionNotFoundError (L84) extends LookupError — inconsistent exception base class choice for sibling contribution errors.
